notes.title: Bacterian Early Access is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Good news, germ-killers! 🦠[hr][/hr]
Get ready, everyone, as your microscopic adventure is about to begin. We are extremely happy to announce, that Bacterian has just entered its Early Access phase! From now on, you can dive straight into the unique experience, combining the classic Sokoban-style puzzle mechanics with action-packed gameplay. And here's a short summary for the newcomers 👇



In Bacterian, players take on the role of a brave immune cell, navigating through various levels to combat pathogenic invaders. The game challenges players to think strategically and act swiftly, as they work to protect the body from harmful germs and diseases. With its pixel-art graphics and engaging gameplay, Bacterian promises to captivate both puzzle enthusiasts and action game fans alike.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574862/0db8ab562fefe82c036255f73889a6033e62265d.png"]


We need your feedback 📋[hr][/hr]
As the game enters Early Access, we - the developers - are eager to hear your feedback and opinions about Bacterian. Your thoughts will help us refine and enhance the gaming experience, so please don't hold back!  



Players interested in participating in the Early Access phase can download the game directly from Bacterian's Steam page. We encourage all players who decided to give a game a shot to share their opinions via the feedback form available directly in the game menu. The feedback form is the most convenient and fastest way to provide us with all the necessary information, and filling it out should take you no more than 2 or 3 minutes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574862/1d64900ae90a5f65ebe8a7ed1900cf0c42b13c4b.gif"]


See you soon, everyone! 👀[hr][/hr]
As always, we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions. In case of any questions or concerns, our team will try to answer you as soon as possible. With that behind us, we wish you a great germ-killing experience, everyone. Have fun!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570450/Bacterian/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you and keep an eye on upcoming news.

Bacterian Team

notes.title: Bacterian Early Access is coming on Sep 11th!
notes.content:
Hey there, germs-killers! 🦠[hr][/hr]
We’re thrilled to announce that Bacterian will soon enter Early Access on Steam! Take this unique opportunity to dive into a microscopic world full of strategy, reflex, and fun! Thanks to the Early Access version of the game, you’ll be able to experience the core gameplay loop, experiment with different approaches when fighting pesky virtues, and help us shape the game with your valuable feedback.



Our goal is to build Bacterian together with the community - expanding features, polishing mechanics, and making this pixel-filled little world as engaging as possible. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574862/7f24ae9fb6ac87a4d89e3f8facaa3b77e8c98ac3.png"]


Early Access will start on September 11th 🤩[hr][/hr]
That's right! We want to invite you to join us in the Bacterian EA journey in less than a week. What's more, all the levels planned for the full version will be available to you to play and test... and there are plenty to explore! One of our main goals during the Early Access phase is to learn about your overall impressions of the game, especially the difficulty curve.



Bacterian is an easy-to-play, hard-to-master game, with numerous varied challenges, enemies and mechanics, so we simply can't wait to see how you will do in a role of a brave immune cell. Every voice, every feedback, and every opinion will be extremely important to us, so be sure to share your honest thoughts. Making a long story short - we believe that the help of our community is essential to making our project a truly fun and immersive experience.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574862/c2cd4b592449bad7e236e79b7570e5fc7c417df1.gif"]


See you soon, everyone! 👀[hr][/hr]
We will be sharing more information about the upcoming Early Access version soon, so stay tuned! You can reach us via our Social Media channels, Discord server and Steam Discussions, and our team is always happy to chat. 



Thank you and keep an eye on upcoming news.

Bacterian Team
